title: just-deliver catalog shared resource
description: A platform-owned part (for example the Cosmos DB account), deployed once per scope and read by the parts that name it in 'uses' as ${<name>.<export>} (docs/architecture/components.md section 2). Expressions (${...}) are kept as raw strings by the loader and evaluated later. Unique by name across shared resources, components and runtimes.

name.description: Same pattern as a component name; how other parts read it.

uses.description: The shared resources this one reads. A shared-scope resource uses only shared-scope ones; no cycles (checked by the resolver).

exports.description: The only names other parts may read.
